title: Battle of Pavan Khind
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Pavan Khind", at revision 1370271630, opens: "The Battle of Pavan Khind was a rearguard last stand that took place in September 1660, at a mountain pass in the vicinity of Vishalgad between the forces of the Maratha and the pursuing Bijapur Sultanate forces." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4872000, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1660 last stand of the Maratha rearguard against the Adil Shahi forces following the siege of Panhala". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
